method.cases: the twelve archived sweep dumps under gluon-plan-sweep/ir/, six plan families at one and four warps; the family compilation of each dump is the first of its two compilations

classification.counts_are_not_attribution: a conversion count or a PTX counter is evidence only together with the conversion identity that the count belongs to
classification.eliminated: the conversion is removed by a named pass while the module still holds tensor operations, and no equivalent definition took over its consumers in that transition
classification.folded: the conversion carries no layout change (its source and target encoding resolve equal), or the transition that removes it also recomputes the value for its former consumers
classification.origin: a conversion present in the first snapshot has no creating pass in the dump; its origin is reported as before-the-first-snapshot rather than credited to the first pass
classification.stage_boundary: the tensor-dialect stages end at the first transition whose left snapshot holds a tensor-dialect operation and whose right snapshot holds none; the conversion operations cannot outlive that boundary
classification.surviving: the conversion is still present in the last snapshot of the tensor dialects; it is lowered, not eliminated, by the transition that converts the tensor operations to LLVM
classification.unattributed: the conversion appears before the first snapshot, or disappears without a matched transition, or its transition has no named pass

method.library_entry_point: test.lib.tensor_compiler_observation.observe_pass_dumps(dump, target_passes=..., rematerialization=True) over the archived text
method.no_new_device_run: these dumps and the PTX/LLIR beside them were produced by the recorded sweep; this analysis re-reads them and adds no compilation

observer_limitations.effect: an encoding printed inline in parameterized form cannot be read: the regex has no way past the inner '>', so the conversion reports source == target and is excluded from the effective count
observer_limitations.handling: the driver re-reads every tensor type by bracket matching and reports both readings per conversion
observer_limitations.observed_impact: in the four [4,8] family dumps the library reads 4 of 11 conversions as effective while 8 change encoding; every Track A table that labelled the total conversion count 'effective' inherits this

observer_limitations.counterexample: Gluon track C: 10 of 14 conversions report region 'module' at snapshot 1, while the same lines are inside @generated_region_kernel
observer_limitations.effect: one scope is popped per line that starts with a brace, so an operation printed in generic form ('tt.reduce' ... ({ ... }) : ...) drifts the scope stack; values inside a function then report 'module', and repackaged regions appear as moves
observer_limitations.handling: the driver tracks scopes by pushing only on a line that ends with '{' and popping by the net brace count; the correction now also exists in the library from parallel work, and the two readings agree on every conversion occurrence of these dumps
observer_limitations.observed_impact: the library reading reports 86 conversions as moved between regions in the 12 Track C dumps; the corrected map places every one of them inside tt.func / scf.for, and the only region change is the loop the same transition folds away

provenance.assembling_script: build_deliverable.py writes these files and embeds the digests above, so it records every digest except its own; it adds no measurement of its own
provenance.import_root_export: git checkout-index -a --prefix=<dir>/ of the committed tree, rsynced to the host
provenance.imported_module_note: every test/lib module of the imported revision, not only the ones this analysis names; the import root is an export of the committed tree, so these are the committed blobs
provenance.pass_dump_capture: REFRACTIR_TRITON_PASS_DUMP=1 with MLIR_DUMP_PATH set by test.lib.triton_case_worker.configure_pass_dumps; one file per worker compilation in runs/compiled/compiler-pass-dump.txt
provenance.working_tree_note: the runs imported test/lib/tensor_compiler_observation.py at the committed revision (182fb3f7...); the working tree has since gained a region-map fix from parallel work (d27d270a...), and the driver's own region tracker agrees with it on every conversion occurrence of these dumps
